note: P4302 (Pro 27:15) — a continual dripping and a quarrelsome wife are alike.

dims.v: contention — the wife whose strife is a ceaseless drip
the quarreling/contention of a wife, as maddening and relentless as a continual dripping on a rainy day — strife that wears by sheer persistence
(the ceaseless dripping it is likened to)
the endless contention that wears a man down drop by drop

midyan (quarrel/contention) — 'a continual dripping on a rainy day and a QUARRELSOME wife are alike' (cf 19:13; 21:9); nagging strife wears by relentless repetition, like water dripping without end. Contention's power is its ceaselessness.
